answer.reason: Two events happened at the Corner Gate: Jehoash broke down the wall as far as it, and Uzziah built towers there; the prophecies only mark boundaries.

clauses.english: was where the wall was broken down by Jehoash of Israel, four hundred cubits from the gate of Ephraim
clauses.quote: brake down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim unto the corner gate, four hundred cubits

clauses.english: was where Uzziah built and fortified towers
clauses.quote: Uzziah built towers in Jerusalem at the corner gate

doubts: JER 31:38 and ZEC 14:10 are prophecies marking boundaries and were left out.
